name: Mobile Suit Gundam RE:0079
author: Sevchenko + GrayKitsune
description:
Changelog (2.8): 
Redistributed GM license (rearranged and decompressed).
Reworked GM (60mm is now integrated) and GM Gunslinger (buffed Quick Draw and added another trait).
Split Light-Type GunCannon to separate License.
Filled up said license with more weapons and systems.
Changed the LL4 Beam Rifle's limited charges from 7 to 5, and refashioned it to the Gundam Ground Type's Beam Rifle.

Changelog (2.9): 
Redistributed GM license (rearranged and decompressed).
Reworked GM Gunslinger (fixed Quick Draw to have half damage dealt. and altered the Frames Attributes).
Light Type GunCannon at LL3 gets GM "Prometheus" Model Ultracompact Fusion Reactor and no longer has the EXOTIC tag.  Electromagnetic Actuators moved to LL2. Has the new LL2 weapon mod "Super Napalm Rocket Launcher"!

Changelog (3.0):
This is the latest update. It fixes the Hyper Hammer Profile name to designate it as a Melee instead of a CQB weapon.

Changelog (3.1): 
Changed Hyper Hammer's Threat from 3 to 5, and removed Range 5.

Changelog (0.3.3.3):
GunCannon Light-Type license and frame reworks
Hyper Weapons System is split into Hyper Beam Cannon & Hyper Hammer and Grappling Anchor, no longer integrated!
HBC changed from Heat 2 (self) to Loading, damage buffed to 3d3+3
Super Napalm moved to LL0 (free stuff!)

Changelog (0.3.3.4):
Changed wording on GCL Core Active for clarification

Changelog (0.3.3.4.1):
Re-added Destroid Tomahawk weapons and systems; Tomahawk banner cleanup
